parent_v21.authoritative_status_at_freeze: GitHub Actions queued; no v21 result file yet committed

scientific_question: When identical final source sets and equilibrium occupancy can arise from different activation histories, how many post-activation occupancy snapshots are needed to identify the history or the history-relevant provenance target?

latent_rows.reuse: the exact 384 v21 three-source clustered/dispersed directed landscapes and the same three source-activation histories

observation_library.snapshot_content: complete binary occupancy set over non-source nodes at the stated structural time
observation_library.equilibrium_snapshot: included as a separately audited negative-control action but not counted among transient snapshot times
observation_library.reason_for_starting_at_t4: all three source identities are active by t4, preventing trivial history identification by directly observing which source has not yet activated

targets.full_activation_history: exact identity of the three frozen activation schedules
targets.equilibrium_provenance_class: equivalence class of activation histories that induce the same equilibrium earliest-origin map
targets.equilibrium_occupancy: negative-control target; identical by construction across histories

exact_design.for_each_row_and_placement: enumerate all subsets of transient snapshot times and find the minimum subset whose joint occupancy signatures separate all target-discordant activation histories
exact_design.insufficient_library: minimum size null if no subset of {4,5,6,8} resolves the target
exact_design.zero_measurement_identification: allowed when all three activation histories already share the same target value

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every eligible row/design, the equilibrium occupancy snapshot is identical across all activation histories and cannot distinguish full history identity.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row/design has a finite minimum transient-snapshot set that exactly identifies all three activation histories.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if full history identity is never resolvable from the frozen transient snapshot library.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Among row/design cases with finite full-history designs, pooled mean minimum snapshot count is strictly smaller for dispersed than clustered placement.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if dispersed-minus-clustered mean minimum snapshot count is >=0.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every eligible row/design, the minimum snapshot burden for equilibrium provenance class is <= the burden for full activation-history identity, treating insufficiency as infinity.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row/design requires fewer snapshots for equilibrium provenance class than for full activation-history identity.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if target-specific provenance never reduces snapshot burden.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row/design exactly identifies full activation history with one transient occupancy snapshot.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every resolvable full-history case requires at least two snapshots.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row/design remains non-identifiable for full activation history even after all four transient snapshots are observed.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the complete transient snapshot library identifies history everywhere.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across the panel, the single best one-snapshot time is not always the latest transient time t8; at least one row/design is resolved by an earlier single snapshot while t8 alone is insufficient.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if t8 weakly dominates every earlier single snapshot in every row/design.

secondary_outputs: minimum snapshot-count distribution by placement design and target
rows where provenance is identified with zero snapshots because all histories share one provenance class
rows where full-history identity is impossible but provenance class is already identified
relationship between v21 transient Jaccard sensitivity and v22 minimum snapshot burden
relationship between v21 provenance-memory fraction and v22 provenance observability
claim_boundary: A snapshot is complete binary structural occupancy, not a real imperfect survey.
Snapshot time is graph-step time, not calibrated calendar time.
History identifiability is limited to the three frozen activation schedules.
A small synthetic snapshot burden is not a field sampling recommendation.
stop_rules: Do not add pre-t4 snapshots after scoring.
Do not add more snapshot times after scoring.
Do not change target definitions after scoring.
Do not add a different observation type to rescue an unresolved history.
